mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS reservation_id, mr.id AS request_id, mr.customer_id, r.status AS reservation_status, p.status AS payment_status, p.id, p.amount, q.total_amount AS quote_amount, p.order_id, p.payment_key, customer.name AS customer_name, mr.request_no FROM reservation r JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = r.move_request_id JOIN quote q ON q.id = r.quote_id JOIN app_user customer ON customer.id = mr.customer_id LEFT JOIN payment p ON p.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{reservationId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler} AND (#{customerId} IS NULL OR mr.customer_id = #{customerId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}) LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id, p.reservation_id, mr.id AS request_id, mr.customer_id, r.status AS reservation_status, p.status AS payment_status, p.amount, q.total_amount AS quote_amount, p.order_id, p.payment_key, customer.name AS customer_name, mr.request_no FROM payment p JOIN reservation r ON r.id = p.reservation_id JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = r.move_request_id JOIN quote q ON q.id = r.quote_id JOIN app_user customer ON customer.id = mr.customer_id WHERE p.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT p.id, p.reservation_id, mr.id AS request_id, mr.customer_id, r.status AS reservation_status, p.status AS payment_status, p.amount, q.total_amount AS quote_amount, p.order_id, p.payment_key, customer.name AS customer_name, mr.request_no FROM payment p JOIN reservation r ON r.id = p.reservation_id JOIN move_request mr ON mr.id = r.move_request_id JOIN quote q ON q.id = r.quote_id JOIN app_user customer ON customer.id = mr.customer_id WHERE p.id = #{paymentId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler} AND (#{customerId} IS NULL OR mr.customer_id = #{customerId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (id, reservation_id, payment_provider, order_id, amount, status, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{reservationId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, 'TOSS_PAYMENTS', #{orderId}, #{amount}, 'READY', #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET payment_key = #{paymentKey}, status = 'IN_PROGRESS', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}
UPDATE payment SET status = 'FAILED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}
UPDATE move_request SET status = 'RESERVED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{requestId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler} AND status = 'QUOTED'
UPDATE payment SET status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_event (id, payment_id, provider_event_id, event_type, payload_summary, processed_at, processing_status) VALUES (#{id,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{paymentId,typeHandler=com.platform.reservation.UuidTypeHandler}, #{providerEventId}, #{eventType}, CAST(#{payloadSummary} AS jsonb), now(), 'PROCESSED') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
